subject: Sponsored isolated eval — data sovereignty & audit packet
messages:
From: Lara Ortiz <lara.ortiz@acumed.io>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Hwang <tom.hwang@acumed.io>, AcuMed Security <sec@acumed.io>
Date: Sat, 15 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Sandbox for isolated VPC eval + evidence we need

Hi Sean —

Thanks for the quick intro last week. We’re moving forward with a technical proof-of-concept but our procurement and security teams require an isolated evaluation with data residency controls (VPC peering or private deployment), plus an audit packet before we can sign an MSA.

High-level asks:
- 30–45 day isolated evaluation environment (no shared tenant)
- Sponsored credits for the eval (we’re a mid-size health-tech org subject to state data residency rules)
- SOC 2 type 2 snapshot or equivalent security evidence, network diagram for the sandbox, and an NDA copy

Attached is our vendor questionnaire — can your team complete the sections that are compliance/security specific? We’re hoping to have the sandbox live by the week of Aug 24.

Thanks,
Lara Ortiz
Head of Product Ops | AcuMed
[lara.ortiz@acumed.io]
[attachment: acumed_vendor_questionnaire.pdf (PDF)]

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Lara Ortiz <lara.ortiz@acumed.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 15 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sandbox for isolated VPC eval + evidence we need

Lara —

Appreciate the clear list. We can support an isolated evaluation with a private VPC deployment and provide sponsored credits for the duration of the trial. Quick notes and next steps from our side:

1) Sponsorship: we can cover up to $12k in credits for a 30–45 day test. If you need an extension we can approve a one-time top-up after the initial trial review.

2) Evidence packet: I’ve attached our SOC 2 snapshot and a standard sponsorship/terms PDF. Rishi (security) will validate anything extra you need for the questionnaire.

3) Timeline: to hit Aug 24 we need signed onboarding docs (NDA + SOW) and confirmation of the VPC CIDR and peering requirements by Aug 20.

4) Logistics: Marissa will own onboarding and technical enablement; Laura will coordinate the credit issuance and the partner billing paperwork.

I’ll start the internal approvals for the sponsorship and loop in infra for a private sandbox build once we have NDA + CIDR.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
[attachment: redwood_sponsorship_terms.pdf (PDF)]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Sandbox for isolated VPC eval + evidence we need

Sean / team —

Quick security checklist for AcuMed’s questionnaire and the sandbox build:
- Provide SOC 2 snapshot (attached) and our standard security FAQ for vendor assessments.
- Network diagram: for private VPC we need AcuMed CIDR blocks, allowed egress endpoints (we restrict that for air-gapped customers), and any IP allowlist for management.
- Data residency: confirm whether PHI will be used in the sandbox. If yes, we need a signed DPA and explicit encryption-at-rest policy acknowledgment from AcuMed.
- Audit logs: we’ll provide access to the audit log stream (read-only) during the eval; if they need longer retention that’s a separate add-on.

Credit controls: set a hard cap on credits and enable alerts at 70%/90% usage — Laura can configure. Recommend we provision the initial $12k as Sean outlined and mark any additional top-ups subject to a 1:1 technical review after day 21.

I’ll prepare a redwood_audit_faq.txt and our minimal SOC snapshot for them to attach to their questionnaire.

Rishi
Security & Compliance, Redwood
[attachment: redwood_soc2-snapshot.pdf (PDF)]

From: Lara Ortiz <lara.ortiz@acumed.io>

Subject: Re: Sandbox for isolated VPC eval + evidence we need

Hi Sean —

This is great — thanks to you and the security team for the fast turnaround. We reviewed the SOC snapshot and the sponsorship terms; we’ll sign the NDA and return it by EOD tomorrow. A few quick clarifications from procurement/security:

• We will not put PHI into the trial environment initially — synthetic payloads instead. If we move to real data we’ll circle back for the DPA.
• CIDR for peering: 10.42.0.0/16 (we’ll confirm subnet layout after NDA).
• Can you confirm the $12k cap and the 21-day review trigger for top-ups? Also need the DocuSign link for the NDA + SOW so I can route to legal.

Attached the vendor questionnaire with a few fields for your team (sections 3–6). If you can complete those before Tuesday morning we can keep the Aug 24 kickoff.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this live.

Best,
Lara Ortiz
Head of Product Ops | AcuMed
